parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to ignore the cluster status and forcibly restart the cluster.

- true: ignores the cluster status
- false (default): does not ignore the cluster status
